info.title: Kinly API
info.description: Contract foundation for Kinly's versioned product API. No product operations are implemented yet. Operational actuator endpoints are intentionally outside this contract.

x-kinly-versioning.compatibleChanges: Additive fields and operations may remain in v1 when existing clients continue to work.
x-kinly-versioning.breakingChanges: Breaking request or response changes require a new major API base path and an approved migration plan.
